content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The site follows the two: S3-err leaves the failure a value below the envelope and S4-own leaves refusing to the envelope, so production sits with the invocation that read the file and rendering with the envelope; S5-marker-corrupt fixes that the file refuses. Fail if the claim moves either — name it.
content.rationale: The refusal's production site is where failure-as-a-value, refusal authority, and the corrupt-file refusal meet; this check forces the site to answer to all three without re-deciding any.
